segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text:
Hi Jordan,

Attached is the draft order form for 72 Support seats and the implementation package. Target go-live is March 18, assuming we get the data export by February 28.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike
segments.text:
Maya,

Thanks. Two things: we only need 68 seats at launch, not 72, and Finance wants annual invoicing with net 30. Can you revise before I send it to Nina?

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text:
Yep, I can move it to 68 seats and annual net 30. The billing tool will show the first invoice for April 1 since March is implementation only.

Do you want the admin training on March 12 or March 14?

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike
segments.text:
March 14 works.

Also, per our text thread this morning, we’re aligned on $41,200 for year one, not the $46,750 still showing on the quote. I understand that lower number has not gone through deal desk or the pricing sheet approval yet. You said we can proceed on the cheaper number now and you’ll sort the paperwork/approvals later so it doesn’t hold up procurement. Please make sure nothing different lands with our AP team.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text:
Understood. I’ll send a clean order form today with 68 seats, annual invoice, net 30, and March 14 admin training.

For implementation contacts, should I list you and Priya Shah?

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike
segments.text:
Yes, list me and Priya. AP contact is invoices@northlakeparts.com. PO is required; I should have it by Friday if the order form is in today.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text:
Thanks. Revised order form is attached. I also added the security addendum from legal and left the auto-renewal at 12 months with 60 days’ notice, per your redlines.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Pike
segments.text:
Got it. I forwarded to Nina and procurement. If they don’t ask for changes, we’ll sign by January 31.

Jordan
